title: Capacity Using Cups and Containers
introduction: Explore capacity using cups and containers using everyday examples.
definition: Capacity describes how much a container can hold. Fill containers with the same sized cup to compare their capacities. Count complete cups and avoid spilling.

visuals.label: Three equal cups
visuals.alt: Three equal cups — Count the same-sized cups.

examples.question: A jug holds five equal cups.

exercises.question: A bottle holds 3 cups. Another holds 6. Larger capacity in cups?
A bucket holds 8 cups; add 3 cups. Empty capacity in cups?
Two jugs hold 4 cups each. Total?
Should comparison cups have equal size? yes/no
A jug holds 7 cups; remove 2 from a full jug. Remaining?
A cup holds less than a jug of 5 such cups. How many cups fill the jug?
